scene: You push through the roof trapdoor onto a breezy neon rooftop garden.
picture: A flat side view of a rooftop garden with artificial grass along the level roof floor. On the far left, a bush glows with bright blue berries. Left of centre, the silver-haired boy in a mint hoodie and dance bag stands by the open trapdoor. At centre stands a motionless mechanical neon flamingo. On the far right idles a large delivery drone.
shown: a glowing blue berry bush standing on the far left
a mechanical glowing pink flamingo standing idle at centre
a large hover delivery drone idling on the far right
